"""Run aerial --flips; require both fresh exact kineticSway MOD rows and whole-driver success."""
import sys

from restring_style_proof import read_result, run_proof
from validation_aerial import KINETIC_DAMAGE, KINETIC_ROWS


def check_result(path, started, finished):
    rows = read_result(path, started, finished, "flips", fields={"kineticDamage": KINETIC_DAMAGE})
    if any(r.get("status") in ("FAIL", "UNMEASURED") for r in rows):
        raise ValueError("aerial driver has failed or unmeasured rows")
    selected = []
    for rid, enabled in zip(KINETIC_ROWS, (True, False)):
        exact = [r for r in rows if r.get("id") == rid]
        if len(exact) != 1 or exact[0].get("status") != "PASS" or exact[0].get("class") != "MOD":
            raise ValueError("requires exactly one %s MOD PASS" % rid)
        detail = exact[0].get("detail")
        if not isinstance(detail, dict) or type(detail.get("schema")) is not int or detail["schema"] != 1 or \
                detail.get("setting") != "kineticSway" or detail.get("enabled") is not enabled or \
                detail.get("damageDef") != KINETIC_DAMAGE or detail.get("damageSelector") != KINETIC_DAMAGE:
            raise ValueError("requires registered kineticSway census evidence")
        delta = detail.get("censusSwayDelta")
        if detail.get("synthetic") is not False or detail.get("kinetic") is not True or detail.get("harmsHealth") is not True or \
                type(detail.get("spansReached")) is not int or detail["spansReached"] <= 0 or \
                detail.get("settingBefore") != str(enabled) or detail.get("settingAfter") != str(enabled) or \
                type(delta) is not int or not (delta > 0 if enabled else delta == 0) or \
                type(detail.get("censusCutDelta")) is not int or detail["censusCutDelta"] != 0 or detail.get("spanStillUp") is not True:
            raise ValueError("requires observed real kinetic blast, setting readbacks and census deltas")
        selected.append(exact[0])
    return selected


def main(argv=None):
    return run_proof(argv, mode="flips", prefix="kinetic-", check=check_result,
                     driver_args=("--kinetic-damage", KINETIC_DAMAGE))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Run aerial --live and require its fresh exact M15f MOD PASS. Retain every attempt."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

ROW = "M15f_restring_joined_run_one_look"


def read_result(path, started, finished, mode, *, fields=None):
    """Unique output plus a creation-window check prevents a previous run from satisfying A1."""
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file() or not started <= path.stat().st_mtime <= finished:
        raise ValueError("no fresh aerial output")
    result = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise ValueError("malformed aerial result")
    if result.get("script") != "validation_aerial.py" or result.get("mode") != mode or result.get("aborted"):
        raise ValueError("wrong or aborted aerial driver")
    rows = result.get("rows")
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not all(isinstance(r, dict) for r in rows):
        raise ValueError("malformed rows")
    if fields and any(result.get(key) != value for key, value in fields.items()):
        raise ValueError("wrong aerial driver options")
    return rows


def check_result(path, started, finished):
    rows = read_result(path, started, finished, "live")
    exact = [r for r in rows if r.get("id") == ROW]
    if len(exact) != 1 or exact[0].get("status") != "PASS" or exact[0].get("class") != "MOD":
        raise ValueError("requires exactly one %s MOD PASS" % ROW)
    detail = exact[0].get("detail")
    if not isinstance(detail, dict) or type(detail.get("schema")) is not int or detail["schema"] != 1 or \
            detail.get("jobDef") != "RM_RestringSpan":
        raise ValueError("requires the colonist-job M15f evidence schema")
    return exact[0]


def run_proof(argv, *, mode, prefix, check, driver_args=()):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--out-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--max-seconds", type=int, default=900)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.max_seconds <= 0:
        parser.error("--max-seconds must be positive")
    Path(args.out_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    attempt = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=prefix, dir=args.out_dir)).resolve()
    output = attempt / "aerial.json"
    command = [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name("validation_aerial.py")), "--" + mode,
               *driver_args, "--out", str(output)]
    receipt = {"command": command, "started": time.time(), "timeout": args.max_seconds}
    code = 1
    try:
        with (attempt / "stdout.txt").open("wb") as stdout, (attempt / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
            child = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                                   timeout=args.max_seconds, check=False)
        receipt["driverReturncode"] = child.returncode
        receipt["finished"] = time.time()
        row = check(output, receipt["started"], receipt["finished"])
        receipt["row"] = row
        if child.returncode != 0:
            raise ValueError("aerial driver returned %s" % child.returncode)
        code = 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as ex:
        receipt["error"] = "%s: %s" % (type(ex).__name__, ex)
    receipt["finished"] = time.time()
    receipt["returncode"] = code
    (attempt / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"attempt": str(attempt), **receipt}, indent=2))
    return code


def main(argv=None):
    return run_proof(argv, mode="live", prefix="a1-", check=check_result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# selftest-timeout: 240
"""Compile actual production AerialMath and exact AerialProbe explode branch with explicit engine doubles.

This proves parsing, registered lookup dispatch and reply identity offline; no real engine effects.
The ordinary GSS SelfTest separately retains SwitchFlipChecks and AerialSelfTest entry points.
"""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent / "Utils"))
import winbuild


def run(source=HERE):
    source = Path(source)
    probe = (source / "Source/Aerial/AerialProbe.cs").read_text()
    start = probe.index('            if (cmd.StartsWith("explode:"))')
    end = probe.index('            if (cmd.StartsWith("set:"))', start)
    branch = probe[start:end]
    start = probe.index('            string cmd = request.')
    end = probe.index('            request = "";', start)
    normalization = probe[start:end]
    harness = (HERE / "Source/SelfTest/ExplodeProbeChecks.cs").read_text()
    math = (source / "Source/Aerial/AerialMath.cs").read_bytes()
    base = Path(winbuild.BUILD_ROOT) / "gss-explode-checks"
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="parse-", dir=base) as directory:
        work = Path(directory)
        (work / "AerialMath.cs").write_bytes(math)
        (work / "Program.cs").write_text(harness.replace("// PRODUCTION_EXPLODE_BRANCH", branch).replace(
            "// PRODUCTION_REQUEST_NORMALIZATION", normalization))
        project = work / "Parse.csproj"
        project.write_text('<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk"><PropertyGroup><OutputType>Exe</OutputType>'
                           '<TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework><ImplicitUsings>disable</ImplicitUsings>'
                           '<Nullable>disable</Nullable></PropertyGroup></Project>')
        print("source=" + str(source), flush=True)
        print("production_math_sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(math).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        print("production_branch_sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(branch.encode()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        print("production_normalization_sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(normalization.encode()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        result = winbuild.run_interop_captured([winbuild.dotnet_exe(), "run", "--project", winbuild.win(str(project)),
                                               "-c", "Release"], cwd=str(work), timeout=180,
                                              capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(result.stdout, end="", flush=True)
        print(result.stderr, end="", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return result.returncode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(run())

class Bridge:
    def __init__(self, change=None, registered_available=True):
        self.change = change or (lambda phase, reply: None)
        self.serial = 0
        self.sways, self.cuts = 7, 4  # cumulative counts deliberately nonzero in both arms
        self.enabled = True
        self.arm = 0
        self.exploded = False
        self.calls = []
        self.registered_available = registered_available

    def scene(self, *_):
        self.arm += 1
        self.exploded = False
        return self.arm * 2, self.arm * 2 + 1, True

    def ticks(self, count):
        self.calls.append(("ticks", count))

    def call(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append((args, kwargs))
        return {"success": True}

    def ap(self, cmd):
        self.calls.append(cmd)
        self.serial += 1
        reply = {"success": True, "cmd": cmd, "_probeSerial": self.serial}
        if cmd.startswith("set:"):
            self.enabled = cmd.endswith("True")
            reply["value"] = str(self.enabled)
            phase = "set"
        elif cmd in ("defaults", "skipreseed:false"):
            phase = "defaults"
        elif cmd.startswith("explode:"):
            selector = cmd.rsplit(",", 1)[1]
            if selector != "kinetic" and not self.registered_available:
                return dict(reply, success=False, error="unknown damage defName " + selector)
            self.exploded = True
            delta = int(self.enabled)
            self.sways += delta
            reply.update(cuts=0, sways=delta, damageDef="Bomb" if selector == "kinetic" else selector,
                         synthetic=selector == "kinetic",
                         kinetic=True, harmsHealth=True, spansReached=1)
            phase = "explode"
        elif cmd == "census":
            left, right = self.arm * 2, self.arm * 2 + 1
            reply.update(kineticSways=self.sways, explosionCuts=self.cuts,
                         settings={k: str(self.enabled) if k == "kineticSway" else "True" for k in
                                   ("kineticSway", "dripLoops", "cutWiresOnOwnerChange", "keepWiresOnGravship")},
                         anchors=[{"id": pid, "x": pos[0], "z": pos[1], "net": 11,
                                   "links": [{"other": other, "state": "Up", "hp": 30.0}]}
                                  for pid, pos, other in ((left, A.F1, right), (right, A.F2, left))])
            phase = "after" if self.exploded else "before"
        else:
            raise AssertionError(cmd)
        self.change(phase, reply)
        return reply


def run_rows(bridge, damage=A.KINETIC_DAMAGE):
    rows = []
    with mock.patch.object(A, "_scene_pair", side_effect=bridge.scene):
        if damage is None:
            A.kinetic_sway_rows(bridge, rows)
        else:
            A.kinetic_sway_rows(bridge, rows, damage=damage)
    return rows


class Rows(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gss_only_default_and_explicit_missing_registered_definition(self):
        generic = Bridge(registered_available=False)
        rows = run_rows(generic, damage=None)
        self.assertEqual([r["status"] for r in rows], ["PASS", "PASS"], rows)
        self.assertEqual(generic.calls.count("explode:98,135,2.5,50,kinetic"), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(r["detail"]["synthetic"] is True and r["detail"]["damageDef"] == "Bomb" for r in rows))
        real = run_rows(Bridge(registered_available=False))
        self.assertEqual([r["status"] for r in real], ["FAIL", "FAIL"], real)

    def test_real_path_and_cumulative_isolation(self):
        b = Bridge()
        rows = run_rows(b)
        self.assertEqual([r["id"] for r in rows], list(A.KINETIC_ROWS))
        self.assertEqual([r["status"] for r in rows], ["PASS", "PASS"], rows)
        self.assertEqual([r["detail"]["censusSwayDelta"] for r in rows], [1, 0])
        self.assertEqual(b.arm, 2)
        self.assertNotEqual(rows[0]["detail"]["anchors"], rows[1]["detail"]["anchors"])
        self.assertEqual(b.calls.count("explode:98,135,2.5,50," + A.KINETIC_DAMAGE), 2)
        self.assertFalse(any(isinstance(c, str) and c.endswith(",kinetic") for c in b.calls))
        self.assertGreater(rows[1]["detail"]["readings"][-1]["reply"]["kineticSways"], 0)
        for row in rows:
            self.assertEqual(row["class"], "MOD")
            self.assertEqual(row["detail"]["setting"], "kineticSway")

    def reject(self, phase, change):
        def edit(current, reply):
            if current == phase:
                change(reply)
        rows = run_rows(Bridge(edit))
        self.assertTrue(all(r["status"] != "PASS" for r in rows), rows)

    def test_all_calls_require_success_echo_and_fresh_serial(self):
        for phase in ("set", "before", "explode", "after"):
            for key, bad in (("success", False), ("success", 1), ("cmd", "old request"),
                             ("_probeSerial", None), ("_probeSerial", True), ("_probeSerial", "3"), ("_probeSerial", 0)):
                with self.subTest(phase=phase, key=key, bad=bad):
                    self.reject(phase, lambda r: r.update({key: bad}))

    def test_counters_and_setting_reads(self):
        for phase in ("before", "after"):
            for key in ("kineticSways", "explosionCuts"):
                for bad in (None, True, "0", 0.0, -1):
                    with self.subTest(phase=phase, key=key, bad=bad):
                        self.reject(phase, lambda r: r.update({key: bad}))
                self.reject(phase, lambda r: r.pop(key))
            for bad in (None, {}, {"kineticSway": True}, {"kineticSway": "not read"}):
                self.reject(phase, lambda r: r.update(settings=bad))
        self.reject("set", lambda r: r.update(value=False))
        self.reject("set", lambda r: r.update(value="not read"))
        for key in ("cuts", "sways"):
            for bad in (None, True, "0", 0.0, -1):
                self.reject("explode", lambda r: r.update({key: bad}))
            self.reject("explode", lambda r: r.pop(key))

    def test_wrong_def_synthetic_fallback_and_cut(self):
        for key, bad in (("damageDef", "Bomb"), ("damageDef", None), ("synthetic", True),
                         ("synthetic", 0), ("synthetic", None), ("cuts", 1), ("kinetic", False),
                         ("kinetic", 1), ("harmsHealth", False), ("spansReached", 0),
                         ("spansReached", True), ("spansReached", "1")):
            self.reject("explode", lambda r: r.update({key: bad}))
        self.reject("after", lambda r: r.update(explosionCuts=r["explosionCuts"] + 1))

    def test_connected_span_is_required_both_directions_before_and_after(self):
        mutations = [lambda r: r.update(anchors=None), lambda r: r.update(anchors=[]),
                     lambda r: r["anchors"].append(copy.deepcopy(r["anchors"][0])),
                     lambda r: r["anchors"][1].update(net=22), lambda r: r["anchors"][1].update(net=True),
                     lambda r: r["anchors"][1].update(links=[]), lambda r: r["anchors"][1].update(x=999),
                     lambda r: r["anchors"][1]["links"][0].update(hp=None),
                     lambda r: r["anchors"][1]["links"][0].update(hp=True),
                     lambda r: r["anchors"][1]["links"][0].update(hp=float("nan")),
                     lambda r: r["anchors"][1]["links"][0].update(state="Cut"),
                     lambda r: r["anchors"][1]["links"].append(copy.deepcopy(r["anchors"][1]["links"][0]))]
        for phase in ("before", "after"):
            for mutation in mutations:
                self.reject(phase, mutation)
        def wound(phase, reply):
            if phase == "after":
                for a in reply["anchors"]: a["links"][0]["hp"] -= 1
        self.assertTrue(all(r["status"] == "FAIL" for r in run_rows(Bridge(wound))))

    def test_same_input_stale_census_and_inverted_setting(self):
        saved = {}
        def stale(phase, reply):
            if phase == "before":
                saved.update(copy.deepcopy(reply))
            if phase == "after":
                reply.clear()
                reply.update(saved)
        self.assertTrue(all(r["status"] == "FAIL" for r in run_rows(Bridge(stale))))
        rows = run_rows(Bridge(lambda phase, r: r["settings"].update(kineticSway="False" if r["settings"]["kineticSway"] == "True" else "True")
                               if phase in ("before", "after") else None))
        self.assertTrue(all(r["status"] == "FAIL" for r in rows))

    def test_zero_on_and_positive_off_deltas_fail(self):
        def zero_on(phase, reply):
            if phase == "after":
                reply["kineticSways"] = 7
        self.assertEqual(run_rows(Bridge(zero_on))[0]["status"], "FAIL")
        def sway_off(phase, reply):
            if phase == "after":

    def test_production_wiring_and_existing_cleanup(self):

    def test_xml_definition_and_inherited_marker(self):
        import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

class Transport(unittest.TestCase):
    def read(self, replies):
        bridge = object.__new__(A.A)
        bridge.call = mock.Mock(side_effect=replies)
        return bridge.ap("census", wait_s=0.01)

    def test_real_transport_reports_serial_and_requires_stable_successful_matching_read(self):
        def sequence():
            return [{"success": True, "value": "9"}, {"success": True}, {"success": True, "value": "10"},
                    {"success": True, "value": json.dumps({"success": True, "cmd": "census"})},
                    {"success": True, "value": "10"}]
        self.assertEqual(self.read(sequence())["_probeSerial"], 10)
        for index, replacement in ((0, {"success": False, "value": 9}), (0, {"success": True, "value": True}),
                                   (2, {"success": True, "value": None}), (3, {"success": False, "value": "{}"}),
                                   (3, {"success": True, "value": json.dumps({"success": True, "cmd": "other"})}),
                                   (4, {"success": True, "value": "11"})):
            replies = sequence()
            replies[index] = replacement
            try:
                result = self.read(replies)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            self.assertIsNot(result.get("success"), True)


class Command(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_actual_cli_default_and_explicit_mode_through_flips_cleanup(self):
        tree = ast.parse(Path(A.__file__).read_text())
        four, = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_four_switches"]
        call, = [n for n in ast.walk(four) if isinstance(n, ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value, ast.Call) and
                 isinstance(n.value.func, ast.Name) and n.value.func.id == "kinetic_sway_rows"]
        wiring = compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[call], type_ignores=[])), A.__file__, "exec")
        for explicit, installed, expected in ((False, False, 0), (True, True, 0), (True, False, 1)):
            b = Bridge(registered_available=installed)
            def selected_block(bridge, rows, result):
                exec(wiring, dict(vars(A), B=bridge, rows=rows, res=result))
            with self.subTest(explicit=explicit, installed=installed), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                output = Path(directory) / "flips.json"
                with mock.patch.object(A, "A", return_value=b), mock.patch.object(A, "flips_block"), \
                     mock.patch.object(A, "_four_switches", side_effect=selected_block), \
                     mock.patch.object(A, "_scene_pair", side_effect=b.scene):
                    code = A.main(["--flips", "--out", str(output)] +
                                  (["--kinetic-damage", A.KINETIC_DAMAGE] if explicit else []))
                self.assertEqual(code, expected)
                result = json.loads(output.read_text())
                self.assertEqual(result["kineticDamage"], A.KINETIC_DAMAGE if explicit else "kinetic")
                self.assertTrue(all(r["status"] == ("PASS" if expected == 0 else "FAIL") for r in result["rows"]))
                self.assertIn("set:kineticSway=True", b.calls)  # actual finally restores the prior setting
        # proof_all's programmatic namespace predates this option. Both driver constructors must keep the fallback.
        for name in ("_run_live", "run_flips"):
            function, = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name]
            self.assertTrue(any(isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and
                                ast.unparse(n).startswith("res['kineticDamage'] = getattr(args, 'kinetic_damage', 'kinetic')")
                                for n in function.body))

    def test_existing_gss_only_bindings_keep_generic_arguments(self):
        root = HERE.parents[2]
        for name in ("GSS_SWITCHES_PROVE_LAST_FOUR_STANDING", "GSS_RESTRING_FIX_STYLES_UNRECONCILED"):
            text = (root / ("infrastructure/state/live_proofs/" + name + ".txt")).read_text()
            self.assertIn("live-mods: GimmeSomeSlack\n", text)
            self.assertNotIn("--kinetic-damage", text)

    def result(self):
        return {"script": "validation_aerial.py", "mode": "flips", "kineticDamage": A.KINETIC_DAMAGE,
                "rows": run_rows(Bridge())}

    def test_both_exact_fresh_mod_rows(self):
        valid = self.result()
        bad = [[], {}, dict(valid, mode="live"), dict(valid, aborted="dead"), dict(valid, rows=[]),
               dict(valid, rows=valid["rows"][:1]), dict(valid, rows=valid["rows"] * 2),
               dict(valid, kineticDamage="kinetic"),
               dict(valid, rows=run_rows(Bridge(registered_available=False), damage=None))]
        missing_mode = copy.deepcopy(valid)
        missing_mode.pop("kineticDamage")
        bad.append(missing_mode)
        for index in (0, 1):
            for field, value in (("id", A.KINETIC_ROWS[index] + "_old"), ("status", "FAIL"),
                                 ("status", "UNMEASURED"), ("class", "HARNESS"), ("detail", {})):
                changed = copy.deepcopy(valid)
                changed["rows"][index][field] = value
                bad.append(changed)
            for field, value in (("synthetic", True), ("damageDef", "Bomb"), ("kinetic", False), ("harmsHealth", False),
                                 ("spansReached", 0), ("censusSwayDelta", True), ("settingAfter", "unknown"),
                                 ("censusCutDelta", 1), ("spanStillUp", False)):
                changed = copy.deepcopy(valid)
                changed["rows"][index]["detail"][field] = value
                bad.append(changed)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "aerial.json"
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                P.check_result(path, 0, time.time())
            for result in [valid, *bad]:
                path.write_text(json.dumps(result))
                stamp = path.stat().st_mtime
                if result is valid:
                    self.assertEqual(len(P.check_result(path, stamp - 1, stamp + 1)), 2)
                else:
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        P.check_result(path, stamp - 1, stamp + 1)

def _ts_count(ln, drip, depth=0.12, reach=0.45, step=0.5):
    """An independent port of AerialMath.SpanCurve / SpanCurveDrip's sample loops (counts the t list they build)."""
    import math
    if not drip or ln < 1e-6:
        return max(4, int(math.ceil(ln / step))) + 1
    reach = min(reach, ln / 4)
    tr = reach / ln
    ts = [tr * k / 12 for k in range(12)]
    n = max(2, int(math.ceil((1 - 2 * tr) * ln / step)))
    ts += [tr + (1 - 2 * tr) * k / n for k in range(n + 1)]
    ts += [1 - tr * k / 12 for k in range(11, -1, -1)]
    return len(ts)


def _into_art(tip, c, slide_dia=None):
    """A strand end as CordBuilder.IntoArt lays it: the routed run up to the plug tip, then (slide) a 0.3 diagonal
    carry in 6 samples, then 0.05 steps to the centroid."""
    pts = [(tip[0], tip[1] - 1.0), (tip[0], tip[1] - 0.5), tip]
    cur = tip
    if slide_dia:
        mid = (tip[0] + slide_dia[0] * 0.3, tip[1] + slide_dia[1] * 0.3)
        pts += [(tip[0] + (mid[0] - tip[0]) * i / 6, tip[1] + (mid[1] - tip[1]) * i / 6) for i in range(1, 7)]
        cur = mid
    d = ((c[0] - cur[0]) ** 2 + (c[1] - cur[1]) ** 2) ** 0.5
    k = max(1, int(d / 0.05 + 0.999))
    pts += [(cur[0] + (c[0] - cur[0]) * i / k, cur[1] + (c[1] - cur[1]) * i / k) for i in range(1, k + 1)]
    return [[round(x, 3), round(z, 3)] for x, z in pts]

class Bridge:
    def __init__(self, fault=None):
        self.fault = fault
        self.sent = []
        self.cut = False
        self.complete = False
        self.ordered = False
        self.job = False
        self.steps = 0
        self.complete_after = 1
        self.counter_base = 0
        self.overrides = {}
        self.looks = ["Scrapper", "Scrapper"]
        self.pawns = [{"id": 7, "pos": [80, 180], "drafted": True, "downed": False, "job": None}]

    def ap(self, cmd):
        self.sent.append(cmd)
        if cmd in self.overrides:
            return copy.deepcopy(self.overrides[cmd])
        ok = {"success": True, "cmd": cmd}
        if cmd.startswith("cut:"):
            self.cut = self.fault != "no_cut"
            return dict(ok, done=self.cut)
        if cmd.startswith("crestyle:"):
            cell, look = cmd[9:].split(":")
            idx = 0 if cell == "%d,%d" % A.M2 else 1
            self.looks[idx] = look.split("_")[0]
            if self.fault == "same_before" and not self.complete:
                self.looks = ["Industrial", "Industrial"]
            return ok
        if cmd == "cprocess":
            return ok
        if cmd == "cstyles":
            looks = list(self.looks)
            if self.complete:
                looks = ["Modern", "Industrial"] if self.fault == "unequal_after" else ["Industrial", "Industrial"]
            if self.fault == "none_after" and self.complete:
                looks[1] = None
            if self.fault in ("missing_style", "none_style", "empty_style"):
                looks[1] = {"none_style": None, "empty_style": ""}.get(self.fault)
            result = dict(ok, defaultKey="Scrapper", members=[
                {"id": i, "x": p[0], "z": p[1], "look": looks[n],
                 "rawStyle": "Style_" + str(looks[n]), "colour": None,
                 "run": 2 if self.complete else i}
                for n, (i, p) in enumerate(((2, A.M2), (3, A.M3)))])
            if self.complete and self.fault == "colour_after":
                result["members"][1]["colour"] = "Orange"
            if self.complete and self.fault == "runs_after":
                result["members"][1]["run"] = 3
            if self.fault == "runs_before" and not self.complete:
                result["members"][1]["run"] = 2
            if self.fault == "raw_style_missing":
                result["members"][1]["rawStyle"] = None
            return result
        if cmd == "census":
            joined = self.complete or not self.cut
            nets = [11, 11] if joined else [11, 22]
            if self.fault == "no_disconnect":
                nets = [11, 11]
            if self.complete and self.fault == "unjoined_after":
                nets = [11, 22]
            return dict(ok, anchors=[
                {"id": i, "x": p[0], "z": p[1], "net": nets[n],
                 "links": [{"other": other, "state": "Up" if joined else "Cut"}]}
                for n, (i, other, p) in enumerate(((2, 3, A.M2), (3, 2, A.M3)))])
        if cmd.startswith("restringorder:"):
            self.ordered = True
        if cmd.startswith("restringjob:"):
            if self.fault == "job_failure":
                return {"success": False, "error": "no free colonist"}
            if self.fault == "direct_bypass":
                self.complete = True
            self.job = True
            self.pawns[0]["job"] = None if self.fault == "not_running" else "RM_RestringSpan"
            return dict(self.state(cmd), by="Human999" if self.fault == "wrong_worker" else "Human7")
        if cmd.startswith("restringstate:") or cmd.startswith("restringorder:"):
            return self.state(cmd)
        if cmd.startswith("restring:"):
            self.complete = True
            return dict(ok, done=True)
        raise AssertionError(cmd)

    def state(self, cmd):
        completed = self.complete and self.fault != "no_completion"
        return {"success": True, "cmd": cmd, "cut": 0 if self.complete else 1,
                "designated": self.ordered and not self.complete,
                "jobsDone": self.counter_base + int(completed), "spansRestrung": self.counter_base + int(completed)}

    def probe(self, cmd):
        self.sent.append(cmd)
        if cmd == "colonists":
            return {"success": True, "cmd": cmd, "pawns": copy.deepcopy(self.pawns)}
        _, rest = cmd.split(":", 1)
        _, action = rest.split("=")
        if action.startswith("tp"):
            self.pawns[0]["pos"] = [80, 180]
            self.pawns[0]["job"] = None
        else:
            self.pawns[0]["drafted"] = action == "draft"
        return {"success": True, "cmd": cmd, "pawn": dict(self.pawns[0])}

    def ticks(self, n):
        self.sent.append(("ticks", n))
        if self.job and n == 250:
            self.steps += 1
            if self.fault != "timeout" and self.steps >= self.complete_after:
                self.complete = True
                self.pawns[0]["job"] = None
                self.pawns[0]["pos"] = [110, 185]


    def call(self, tool, **kwargs):
        self.sent.append((tool, kwargs))
        if tool != "jawa/pawn_get":
            raise AssertionError(tool)
        return {"success": True, "pawns": [{"thingId": kwargs["pawn"], "thingIdNumber":
                                           999 if self.fault == "wrong_worker" else 7}]}

    """M5 (review 9.3): local invalidation needs the far run to HAVE changed (else a build that did nothing passes), the
    build to have succeeded, and nothing outside the far run to have changed."""
    if not (build_resp or {}).get("success"):
        return False
    if not far_keys:
        return False
    return not [k for k in list(changed) + list(gone) if k not in far_keys] and (last_planned or 0) <= 2

    teardown, and the finally cleared SITE only). Returns the rects it tried."""
    done = []
    while OFF_SITE_RECTS:

def _canvas_for(rel):
    n = rel.split("/")[-1]
    if n == "Strand_ScrapTaped":
        return (1024, 32)          # pass 12: a 2.56-cell repeat; the ribbon's repeat follows the texture's aspect (CordMaterials.Aspect)
    if n.startswith("Strand") or n in ("SpanShadow", "SpanWire"):
        return (128, 32)
    if n == "TapClamp":
        return (256, 256)          # art r5 (9245c831b): "256 px tap clamps"
    if n in ("EndFrayed_Dead", "EndFrayed_Live", "SparkGlow"):
        return (64, 64)
    if n == "PowerStrip":
        return (64, 32)
    if n in ("AerialMast", "AerialLampMast"):
        return (128, 256)
    return (128, 128)


def png_sanity(rel):
    """None if the PNG is sane, else why: RGBA, exact canvas, real transparency, not empty, not magenta; a strip
    (Strand*, SpanShadow) must tile: edge-column diff <= max(1.5 x mean adjacent diff, +4)."""
    from PIL import Image
    import numpy as np
    p = os.path.join(HERE, "Textures", "RimMandrake", "GimmeSomeSlack", rel + ".png")
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return "missing"
    im = Image.open(p)
    if im.mode != "RGBA":
        return "mode %s" % im.mode
    want = _canvas_for(rel)
    if im.size != want:
        return "size %s != %s" % (im.size, want)
    a = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
    al = a[:, :, 3]
    if (al > 8).mean() < 0.01:
        return "empty"
    if (al < 8).mean() < 0.02 and not rel.split("/")[-1].startswith("Strand"):
        return "no transparency"
    vis = a[al > 128][:, :3]
    if len(vis) and ((vis[:, 0] > 200) & (vis[:, 1] < 60) & (vis[:, 2] > 200)).mean() > 0.2:
        return "magenta"
    n = rel.split("/")[-1]
    if n.startswith("Strand") or n == "SpanShadow":
        pm = np.concatenate([a[:, :, :3] * (a[:, :, 3:4] / 255.0), a[:, :, 3:4]], axis=2)
        edge = float(np.abs(pm[:, 0] - pm[:, -1]).mean())
        adj = float(np.abs(np.diff(pm, axis=1)).mean())
        if edge > max(1.5 * adj, adj + 4.0):
            return "seam %.1f vs adjacent %.1f" % (edge, adj)
    return None

def _band_px(path, xs=(10, 20)):
    from PIL import Image
    a = Image.open(path).convert("RGBA").getchannel("A")
    return max(sum(1 for y in range(a.size[1]) if a.getpixel((x, y)) > 128) for x in xs)


OWNER_WORDS = ("fire hoses they use", "firehose is shown as going OVER")   # the owner's words, quoted verbatim


def visible_fire_hose(paths):
    """Case-insensitive 'fire hose' / 'firehose' / 'fire-hose' hits in player- or reviewer-visible text (B20): every line
    of the given files except C#/Python identifiers. Returns [(path, line_no, text)]."""
    import re
    rx = re.compile(r"fire[\s_-]?hoses?", re.I)
    hits = []
    for p in paths:
        try:
            lines = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            continue
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines, 1):
            if any(q in ln for q in OWNER_WORDS):
                continue                         # the owner's verbatim words are quoted, never reworded
            for m in rx.finditer(ln):
                pre, post = ln[m.start() - 1:m.start()], ln[m.end():m.end() + 1]
                if "_" in m.group(0) or (pre and (pre.isalnum() or pre == "_")) or (post and (post.isalnum() or post == "_")):
                    continue                     # an identifier (FireHosesMod, fire_hose_x), not text
                hits.append((os.path.relpath(p, REPO), i, ln.strip()[:120]))
    return hits

def o6_review_round1(rows):
    """Owner review round 1 (2026-10-04), the offline half: one load-bearing measurement per art/def bar.

    extension-cord piece takes its cord colour, B6/B16/B19 per-look pole table current, B20 no visible 'fire hose'."""

    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    from PIL import Image
    probs, info = [], []
    tex = os.path.join(HERE, "Textures", "RimMandrake", "GimmeSomeSlack")

        edge = max(a.getpixel((x, y)) for x in range(128) for y in range(128) if x < 6 or y < 6 or x >= 122 or y >= 122)
        if edge != 0:

        probs.append("B3: ConduitVisuals does not swap the switch art")
    # B7: the bracket is placed the vanilla way (Core TorchWallLamp): attachment, not an edifice, drawn 0.9 onto the wall
    root = ET.parse(os.path.join(HERE, "Defs", "Aerial", "RM_AerialAnchors.xml")).getroot()
    br = next(d for d in root.iter("ThingDef") if d.findtext("defName") == "RM_AerialWallBracket")
    pw = [li.text for li in br.findall("placeWorkers/li")]
    gd = br.find("graphicData")
    offs = {k: gd.findtext("drawOffset" + k) for k in ("North", "South", "East", "West")}
    want = {"North": "(0,0,0.9)", "South": "(0,0,-0.9)", "East": "(0.9,0,0)", "West": "(-0.9,0,0)"}
    if br.findtext("building/isAttachment") != "true" or br.findtext("building/isEdifice") != "false" or pw != ["Placeworker_AttachedToWall"] \
            or offs != want or br.findtext("rotatable") != "true":
        probs.append("B7 bracket def: attachment=%s edifice=%s placeWorkers=%s offsets=%s" % (
            br.findtext("building/isAttachment"), br.findtext("building/isEdifice"), pw, offs))
    if "PlaceWorker_AerialWallBracket" in open(os.path.join(HERE, "Source", "Aerial", "PlaceWorkers_Aerial.cs"), encoding="utf-8").read():
        probs.append("B7: the old in-front-of-the-wall placeworker is still in the source")
    # B8/B22 (hose fittings and binding wrap) moved with the hose to FlowWorks/validation_hose_offline.py HO6 (hose port)
    # B14: the recoloured pieces are current, and their cord pixels carry the cord colour (hue within 15 deg)
    rc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(UTILS, "mockups", "messy_conduit", "recolor_extcord_pieces.py"), "--check"],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    if rc.returncode != 0:
        probs.append("B14: recoloured pieces stale: %s" % rc.stdout.strip()[-200:])
    ext = os.path.join(tex, "Styles", "ExtCord")

    def hue(rgb):
        return colorsys.rgb_to_hsv(*[v / 255.0 for v in rgb])[0] * 360

    for c in ("Green", "Brown", "Yellow", "Blue"):
        st = Image.open(os.path.join(ext, "Strand_%s.png" % c)).convert("RGBA")
        sp = [p for p in st.getdata() if p[3] > 128]
        th = hue(tuple(sum(p[i] for p in sp) / len(sp) for i in range(3)))
        src = Image.open(os.path.join(ext, "Junction_T.png")).convert("RGBA")
        var = Image.open(os.path.join(ext, c, "Junction_T.png")).convert("RGBA")
        ch = [q for p, q in zip(src.getdata(), var.getdata()) if p != q and q[3] > 128]
        if not ch:
            probs.append("B14 %s: nothing recoloured" % c)
            continue
        mh = hue(tuple(sum(q[i] for q in ch) / len(ch) for i in range(3)))
        d = min(abs(mh - th), 360 - abs(mh - th))
        if d > 15:
            probs.append("B14 %s: cord pixels hue %.0f vs cord %.0f" % (c, mh, th))
    cm = open(os.path.join(HERE, "Source", "CordMaterials.cs"), encoding="utf-8").read()

            "CordMaterials.Decal(d.Kind, variant)" in sl or ("CordMaterials.DecalG(d.Kind, g)" in sl and "public static Material DecalG(" in cm)):

                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)

        probs.append("B6: pole geometry table stale (re-run wire_pole_art.py)")
    wired = [ln.split(":")[0] for ln in rp.stdout.splitlines() if "crossarm row" in ln]
    info.append("real pole art: %s" % (wired or "none yet (tinted stand-ins)"))

        probs.append("style stage 1 (validation_style.py --offline): %s" % rs.stdout.strip()[-200:])
    # B7 round 2: the wall bracket's per-look, per-facing art and its measured insulator table are current

                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    if rb.returncode != 0:
        probs.append("B7: bracket art / geometry table stale (re-run wire_bracket_art.py): %s" % rb.stdout.strip()[-200:])
    info.append("bracket art: %s" % [ln.split(":")[0] for ln in rb.stdout.splitlines() if ": wired" in ln])
    # B20: no visible 'fire hose' text, and the sweep can see one (sanity probe)

    if len(probe) != 1:
        probs.append("B20 sweep cannot see a planted 'Fire Hose' (%d hits)" % len(probe))

def tap_letter_problems(anchors_xml, theft_cs):
    """GPT pre-release C5: the theft letter may only offer what the clamp has. 'switch off' needs a CompFlickable on
    RM_PowerTapClamp."""
    import re
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    clamp = next((d for d in ET.parse(anchors_xml).getroot() if d.findtext("defName") == "RM_PowerTapClamp"), None)
    if clamp is None:
        return ["RM_PowerTapClamp not found in %s" % os.path.basename(anchors_xml)]
    flick = any(li.get("Class") == "CompProperties_Flickable" for li in clamp.iter("li"))
    body = open(theft_cs, encoding="utf-8").read()
    advice = re.search(r'StopAdvice\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', body)
    if not advice:
        return ["PowerTheftConsequences.StopAdvice not found"]
    if "switch" in advice.group(1).lower() and not flick:
        return ["C5: the theft letter says %r but the clamp has no CompFlickable" % advice.group(1)]
    return []


def unsaved_component_problems(src_dir):
    """SL2 offline (GSS_SESSION_RESET_REPAIR_SNEAKS_INTO_SAVES, L1 2026-10-15): every Game/Map/WorldComponent GSS
    defines is written into the save as <li Class=...> unless an Expose* patch drops it while saving. So each such class
    must be named by a `c is <Class>` in a [HarmonyPatch(typeof(Game|Map|World), "Expose...")] class. GssSessionReset
    (e42ac437f0) had none and every save named it."""
    import re
    bodies = {}
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(src_dir, "**", "*.cs"), recursive=True):
        if os.sep + "SelfTest" + os.sep in path:
            continue
        bodies[path] = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    comps = set()
    skipped = set()
    for body in bodies.values():
        comps.update(re.findall(r"class\s+(\w+)\s*:\s*(?:GameComponent|MapComponent|WorldComponent)\b", body))
        for m in re.finditer(r'HarmonyPatch\(typeof\((?:Game|Map|World)\),\s*"Expose\w*"\)\]', body):
            nxt = body.find("HarmonyPatch(", m.end())
            skipped.update(re.findall(r"c is (\w+)\)", body[m.end():nxt if nxt > 0 else len(body)]))
    return ["%s is saved (no Expose* patch drops it while saving)" % c for c in sorted(comps - skipped)]


def gpt_read_fix_missing(shapes, src_dir):
    miss = []
    for name, rel, frag in shapes:
        path = os.path.join(src_dir, rel)
        body = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read() if os.path.exists(path) else ""
        if frag not in body:
            miss.append(name)
    return miss

def lamp_register_problems(ours, vanilla):
    """What differs between our lamp mast's light and vanilla's standing lamp (both ThingDef elements). Owner by card
    2026-10-11: "They should be registered just like vanilla Rimworld handles wall lights. Same register." 1.6 code finds
    a light by CompGlower alone, and AtmosphericBase discovers emitters by Building + CompGlower, so the register is:
    category Building, the CompGlower's fields, the ColoredLights power upgrade, Flickable and PlaceWorker_GlowRadius."""
    def glower(d):
        return next((li for li in d.iter("li") if li.get("Class") == "CompProperties_Glower"), None)
    probs = []
    go, gv = glower(ours), glower(vanilla)
    if go is None:
        return ["no CompProperties_Glower on the mast"]
    for f in ("glowRadius", "glowColor", "colorPickerEnabled", "darklightToggle"):
        a, b = (go.findtext(f) or "").replace(" ", ""), (gv.findtext(f) or "").replace(" ", "") if gv is not None else None
        if a != b:
            probs.append("glower %s %r != vanilla %r" % (f, a, b))
    if not any(li.findtext("researchProject") == "ColoredLights" for li in ours.iter("li")):
        probs.append("no ColoredLights power upgrade")
    if not any(li.get("Class") == "CompProperties_Flickable" for li in ours.iter("li")):
        probs.append("not Flickable")
    if "PlaceWorker_GlowRadius" not in [li.text for li in ours.iter("li")]:
        probs.append("no PlaceWorker_GlowRadius")
    return probs

def origin_for_anchor(anchor, size_x, size_z, margin=3):
    """The scene origin that centres the scene on `anchor`, clamped so the whole SITE (+margin) is on the map."""
    mx0, mz0, mx1, mz1 = SCENE_EXTENT
    x = anchor[0] - (mx0 + mx1) // 2
    z = anchor[1] - (mz0 + mz1) // 2
    x = max(margin - mx0, min(size_x - 1 - margin - mx1, x))
    z = max(margin - mz0, min(size_z - 1 - margin - mz1, z))
    return x, z

def inwall_hookup_rows(B, rows):
    """A run wholly inside a wall is how many colonies are wired. Two rooms: a lamp across the floor from the walled run draws one
    cord out of the wall's face (M1e); the same room on HiddenConduit draws nothing (M3 is why: hidden conduit stays hidden)."""
    fx, fz = (X0 - 70, Z0 + 12) if X0 >= 80 else (X0 + 70, Z0 + 12)
    for did, conduit, want in (("M1e_machine_on_inwall_run_draws_a_cord", "PowerConduit", True),
                               ("M1f_machine_on_hidden_conduit_draws_none", "HiddenConduit", False)):
        frect = "%d,%d,12,10" % (fx - 1, fz - 1)
        OFF_SITE_RECTS.append(frect)
        B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects=frect, categories="All")
        B.call("jawa/set_terrain_batch", ops="Soil:" + frect)
        B.call("jawa/set_fog", action="unfog", rect=frect)
        ring = [(fx + i, fz + j) for i in range(10) for j in range(8) if i in (0, 9) or j in (0, 7)]
        walls = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("Wall", ring), faction="player", stuff="Steel", wipeExisting=False)
        run = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops(conduit, ring), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
        lamp = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="StandingLamp:%d,%d" % (fx + 4, fz + 4), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
        B.ticks(3)
        B.probe("rebuild")
        built = walls.get("survived") == len(ring) and run.get("survived") == len(ring) and lamp.get("survived") == 1
        c = B.probe("rect:%s" % frect)
        pos = [n["t"] for n in c.get("nodes") or []]
        got = (c.get("cordEdges") or 0) >= 1 and (c.get("decals") or {}).get("StubWall", 0) >= 1
        row(rows, did, "UNMEASURED" if not built else ("PASS" if got == want and c.get("verticesInUnwalkable") == 0 else "FAIL"),
            "SITE" if not built else "MOD",
            {"built": built, "cordEdges": c.get("cordEdges"), "decals": c.get("decals"), "nodeTypes": sorted(set(pos)), "unwalkable": c.get("verticesInUnwalkable"), "wantCord": want})
        B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects=frect, categories="All")
        OFF_SITE_RECTS.remove(frect)
        fz += 12


def live_battery(B, fresh_map=False, rows=None):
    """The live tier on B's map. `rows` (optional) is filled in place, so a caller sees every row measured
    before an abort."""
    rows = [] if rows is None else rows
    log = []
    res = {"mod": MOD, "mode": "live", "tier": TIER, "started": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "rows": rows}
    if fresh_map:
        import bridge_concurrency_guard as _G
        _G.refuse_if_foreign_activity("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
        B.call("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
        r = B.call("rimworld/start_debug_game_ready", readiness="mapData", pauseIfNeeded=True, timeoutMs=280000)
        from await_lifecycle import await_lifecycle  # noqa: E402  (READYWAITS_MIGRATE_REMAINING_52_COPIES)
        lc = await_lifecycle(B.call, "map_ready", 180, poll_s=2.0)
        st = lc.last.get("programState")
        hrow(rows, "L0_fresh_map", "PASS" if lc.ok else "FAIL", "SITE",
             {"start": r.get("success"), "programState": st, "wait": lc.reason})
        if not lc.ok:
            res["aborted"] = "no fresh map: %s" % lc.reason
            return res
    # environment fingerprint for `modcheck record`
    env = {}
    rm = B.call("jawa/running_mods", assembly="RimMandrakeGimmeSomeSlack", details=False)
    if rm.get("success"):
        import hashlib
        env["running"] = [p.lower() for p in rm.get("packageIds") or []]
        env["running_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256("\n".join(env["running"]).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        ms = (rm.get("assembly") or {}).get("matches") or []
        env["assembly_matches"] = len(ms)
    res["env"] = env
    try:
        sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(UTILS, "modcheck"))
        import status as _mc  # noqa: E402
        res["mod_hash"] = _mc.mod_hash(HERE)          # the mod DIR; a bare name hashes nothing
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001
        res["mod_hash"] = None
        log.append("mod_hash unavailable: %s" % ex)
    hrow(rows, "L1_tier_running", "PASS" if PKG in env.get("running", []) else "FAIL", "SITE",
        "%d mods running, gimmesomeslack %s" % (len(env.get("running", [])), PKG in env.get("running", [])))
    lg0 = B.call("rimbridge/list_logs", limit=500, minimumLevel="warning")
    logs0 = lg0.get("logs") or []
    log_base = max([x.get("Sequence", 0) for x in logs0] or [0])
    bridge_line = any("[RimBridge]" in (x.get("Message") or "") for x in logs0)
    pre = [x.get("Message", "")[:200] for x in logs0 if "GimmeSomeSlack" in (x.get("Message", "") + x.get("StackTrace", ""))
           and (x.get("Level") or "").lower() in ("error", "exception")]
    if not bridge_line:
        # 2026-10-10 (550-mod list): chatty mods push the startup out of the bridge's last 500 entries; Player.log has it
        # (same fallback as proof_all P2)
        try:
            with open(PLAYER_LOG, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                lines = f.read().splitlines()
            bridge_line = any("[RimBridge]" in ln for ln in lines)
            pre = [ln[:200] for ln in lines if "GimmeSomeSlack" in ln and ("Exception" in ln or "rror" in ln)][:6]
        except OSError:
            pass
    hrow(rows, "L2_startup_log_clean", ("PASS" if not pre else "FAIL") if bridge_line else "UNMEASURED", "MOD",
        pre or "no GimmeSomeSlack error in %d warn+ startup entries (sanity: [RimBridge] line seen=%s)" % (len(logs0), bridge_line))
    pd = B.probe("defaults")
    if not pd.get("success"):
        res["aborted"] = "probe channel dead: %s" % pd
        row(rows, "L3_probe_channel", "FAIL", "HARNESS", pd)
        return res
    t_start = B.probe("census").get("ticksGame")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- site and scene
    x, z, w, h = SITE
    B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE, categories="All")
    B.call("jawa/set_terrain_batch", ops="Soil:%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)
    B.call("jawa/set_fog", action="unfog", rect="%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)
    B.call("jawa/set_roof_batch", ops="None:%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)      # a quicktest map can land on roofed ruins
    walls = [c for c in perimeter(*ROOM) if c != DOOR]
    b1 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("Wall", walls), stuff="Steel", faction="player")
    b2 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="Door:%d,%d" % DOOR, stuff="Steel", faction="player")
    b3 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="Battery:%d,%d,0" % BATTERY, faction="player")
    cond = MAIN + BRANCH + INTO_WALL + FAR
    b4 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("PowerConduit", cond), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
    b5 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="StandingLamp:%d,%d" % LAMP, faction="player")
    built = {k: (v.get("survived"), len(v.get("failed") or [])) for k, v in
             dict(walls=b1, door=b2, battery=b3, conduit=b4, lamp=b5).items()}
    bat_id = None
    for t in (b3.get("things") or b3.get("readBack") or []):
        if "Battery" in str(t.get("defName", "")):
            bat_id = t.get("id") or t.get("thingId")
    if not bat_id:
        lt = B.call("jawa/list_things", defName="Battery", limit=5)
        for t in lt.get("things") or []:
            bat_id = t.get("id") or t.get("thingId")
    bs = B.call("jawa/battery_set", thing=bat_id, mode="setPct", value=1.0) if bat_id else {}
    B.call("jawa/map_commit")
    # Section meshes regenerate only when a section is in VIEW (Section.TryUpdate / DrawSection), so a
    # census of the drawer's sub-meshes needs the camera on the scene (run 2: layerVerts 0 off-screen).
    B.call("rimworld/jump_camera_to_cell", x=X0 + 14, z=Z0 + 4)
    frame_fit(B, SITE)   # 2026-10-10: the kept zoom can be a 12x6 view on the full list (B7 swayDraws 0, R2)
    B.ticks(2)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    ok_scene = b4.get("survived") == len(cond) and bs.get("storedEnergyAfter", 0) > 0
    hrow(rows, "S0_scene_built", "PASS" if ok_scene else "FAIL", "SITE", dict(built, battery=bat_id, stored=bs.get("storedEnergyAfter")))
    c0 = B.probe("census")
    log.append({"census0": c0})

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- M3 / M1: invisible conduit
    tp = c0.get("texPaths") or {}
    inv = c0.get("invisibleApplied") and tp and all(v == TRANSPARENT for v in tp.values()) and \
        c0.get("spawnedConduitTexture") == "ConduitTransparent"
    row(rows, "M1_conduit_transparent", "PASS" if inv else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"texPaths": tp, "spawned": c0.get("spawnedConduitTexture")})
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- M1: cords exist for the network
    nt = c0.get("nodeTypes") or {}
    cords_ok = (c0.get("cordEdges") or 0) >= 4 and (c0.get("layerVerts") or 0) > 0 and c0.get("layerVisible")
    row(rows, "M1_cords_exist", "PASS" if cords_ok else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {k: c0.get(k) for k in ("conduitCells", "cordEdges", "hiddenEdges", "strands", "layerVerts", "layerSectionsWithCords")} | {"nodes": nt})
    want_types = {"battery", "consumer", "junction", "stub_wall"}
    wall_live = [e for e in c0.get("ends") or [] if e.get("wall") and e.get("netLive")]
    row(rows, "M1_node_census", "PASS" if want_types <= set(nt) and nt.get("terminal", 0) >= 2 and wall_live else "FAIL", "MOD",
        "need %s + >=2 terminals (FAR run ends) + a live wall terminal; got %s, live wall ends %d" % (sorted(want_types), nt, len(wall_live)))
    dc = c0.get("decals") or {}
    row(rows, "M1c_end_pieces", "PASS" if dc.get("Plug", 0) > 0 and dc.get("StubWall", 0) > 0 and
        (dc.get("JunctionTape", 0) + dc.get("JunctionTin", 0)) > 0 and (dc.get("FrayDead", 0) + dc.get("FrayLive", 0)) > 0 else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {"decals": dc})
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- M2: connected only, floor rule
    # M2 is written after the break (M8) so it is evaluated on the post-break census too -- see there.
    row(rows, "M2b_no_vertex_unwalkable", "PASS" if c0.get("verticesInUnwalkable") == 0 and c0.get("interiorVertices", 0) > 0 else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {k: c0.get(k) for k in ("verticesInUnwalkable", "interiorVertices", "fellBack", "unroutable")})
    # never_taut_straight_cord (owner 2026-11-07 7:07 PM, Conductor pass rule 2026-11-08 1:18 AM): no turn tighter than 90 degrees within one cell
    # anywhere on a cord, ends included, that no wall, building, door or socket forces (CordShapeAudit.Bends; broad loops are the north star's own)
    kk = (B.probe("bends") or {}).get("tally") or {}
    row(rows, "M2c_no_sharp_bends", "UNMEASURED" if not kk.get("strands") else ("PASS" if kk.get("unforced", 1) == 0 else "FAIL"),
        "MOD" if kk.get("strands") else "HARNESS",
        {"strands": kk.get("strands"), "bends": kk.get("bends"), "unforced": kk.get("unforced"), "why": kk.get("why"),
         "where": [r for r in (kk.get("rows") or []) if r.get("why") == "unforced"][:8], "bar": "zero unforced"})
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- M6: hookup wire hidden, overlay intact
    m6 = (c0.get("hookupWiresSuppressed") or 0) > 0 and (c0.get("overlayConnectorVerts") or 0) > 0
    row(rows, "M6_overlay_lines_intact", "PASS" if m6 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {k: c0.get(k) for k in ("hookupWiresSuppressed", "overlayWiresPrinted", "overlayConnectorVerts")})
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- determinism (fresh builder, same map)
    # D1 (fresh builder reproduces every edge) is the same predicate as the matrix's D2 on a superset of boards; in a
    # SHARED (proof_all) session D2 carries it (consolidation doc section 2 "Determinism"); standalone it stays here.
    if not SHARED:
        fr = B.probe("fresh")
        row(rows, "D1_determinism_fresh_build", "PASS" if fr.get("edges", 0) > 0 and fr.get("different") == 0 and fr.get("missing") == 0 else "FAIL",
            "MOD", fr)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- M5: local invalidation
    hashes0 = c0.get("edgeHashes") or {}
    m5_build = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("PowerConduit", [(FAR[-1][0] + 1, FAR[-1][1])]), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
    B.ticks(2)
    c1 = B.probe("census")
    hashes1 = c1.get("edgeHashes") or {}
    changed = sorted(k for k in hashes0 if k in hashes1 and hashes0[k] != hashes1[k])
    gone = sorted(k for k in hashes0 if k not in hashes1)
    far_keys = [k for k in gone + changed if ("%d," % FAR[0][0]) in k or ("%d," % FAR[-1][0]) in k]
    m5 = m5_verdict(changed, gone, far_keys, c1.get("lastPlanned"), m5_build)
    row(rows, "M5_local_invalidation", "PASS" if m5 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"changed": changed, "gone": gone, "farKeys": far_keys, "buildSuccess": (m5_build or {}).get("success"), "lastPlanned": c1.get("lastPlanned"), "lastReused": c1.get("lastReused")})
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- M8: a break -> two dangling ends
    B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,1,1" % GAP, categories="Building")
    B.ticks(2)
    B.probe("poll")
    c2 = B.probe("census")
    ends = {tuple(e["cell"]): e for e in c2.get("ends") or []}
    west, east = (GAP[0] - 1, GAP[1]), (GAP[0] + 1, GAP[1])
    ew, ee = ends.get(west), ends.get(east)
    m8 = bool(ew and ee and ew.get("registryLive") is True and ee.get("registryLive") is False and
              ew.get("netLive") is True and ee.get("netLive") is False)
    row(rows, "M8_break_two_ends_live_dead", "PASS" if m8 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"west(battery side)": ew, "east": ee, "cordsAcrossNets": c2.get("cordsAcrossNets")})
    # M2 on BOTH the built scene (c0) and the post-break census (c2). The one-cell gap splits the PowerNet, so a cord
    # across it IS a cross-net edge: M8b ("no cord across the gap") is this predicate on c2 and is cut as a row
    # (consolidation doc section 2 "Core": "cut M8b after that one-line harness change").
    m2 = all(c.get("cordsAcrossNets") == 0 and c.get("cordEndsWithoutNet") == 0 for c in (c0, c2))
    row(rows, "M2_cords_only_within_net", "PASS" if m2 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"built": {k: c0.get(k) for k in ("cordsAcrossNets", "cordsAcrossNetsList", "cordEndsWithoutNet")},
         "afterBreak": {k: c2.get(k) for k in ("cordsAcrossNets", "cordsAcrossNetsList", "cordEndsWithoutNet")}})
    try:
        lane_a_live(B, rows, log)
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001
        _reraise_harness_stop(ex)
        row(rows, "P1B_block", "FAIL", "HARNESS", "lane A block raised: %r" % ex)
    try:
        style_live(B, rows, log)
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001
        _reraise_harness_stop(ex)
        row(rows, "ST_block", "FAIL", "HARNESS", "lane C style block raised: %r" % ex)
    # source off -> the live end reads dead within one 250-tick poll, no manual poll
    if bat_id:
        B.call("jawa/battery_set", thing=bat_id, mode="setPct", value=0.0)
    B.ticks(260)
    c3 = B.probe("census")
    e3 = {tuple(e["cell"]): e for e in c3.get("ends") or []}.get(west)
    m8c = bool(e3 and e3.get("netLive") is False and e3.get("registryLive") is False)
    row(rows, "M8c_source_off_reads_dead_250", "PASS" if m8c else "FAIL", "MOD", {"west": e3})
    if bat_id:
        B.call("jawa/battery_set", thing=bat_id, mode="setPct", value=1.0)
    B.ticks(2)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- M7: master off -> vanilla art
    B.probe("set:enabled=False")
    c4 = B.probe("census")
    tp4 = c4.get("texPaths") or {}
    m7 = (not c4.get("invisibleApplied")) and tp4 and all(v != TRANSPARENT for v in tp4.values()) and \
        c4.get("spawnedConduitTexture") not in (None, "ConduitTransparent") and not c4.get("layerVisible")
    row(rows, "M7_off_restores_vanilla", "PASS" if m7 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"texPaths": tp4, "spawned": c4.get("spawnedConduitTexture"), "layerVisible": c4.get("layerVisible")})
    B.probe("set:enabled=True")
    c5 = B.probe("census")
    row(rows, "M7b_on_again_invisible", "PASS" if c5.get("spawnedConduitTexture") == "ConduitTransparent" and c5.get("layerVerts", 0) > 0 else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {"spawned": c5.get("spawnedConduitTexture"), "layerVerts": c5.get("layerVerts")})
    B.probe("defaults")
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- log budget
    lg = B.call("rimbridge/list_logs", limit=500, minimumLevel="warning")
    new = [e for e in lg.get("logs") or [] if (e.get("Sequence") or 0) > log_base]
    errs = [e for e in new if str(e.get("Level", "")).lower() in ("error", "exception")]
    # the scene clear's own destroy_batch over a map geyser/monolith ("Tried to destroy non-destroyable thing
    # SteamGeyser..."): the harness, not the mod -- counted, never charged to the mod (run_live.py does the same)
    site = [e for e in errs if "non-destroyable" in str(e.get("Message", ""))]
    errs = [e for e in errs if e not in site]
    if not SHARED:                   # SHARED: one run-end log budget over the whole session (proof_all Z)
        row(rows, "Z_log_budget", "PASS" if not errs else "FAIL", "MOD",
            {"errors": [str(e.get("Message", ""))[:200] for e in errs[:6]], "newWarnings": len(new), "siteClearErrors": len(site)})
    t_end = B.probe("census").get("ticksGame")
    res["ticks"] = (t_end - t_start) if isinstance(t_end, int) and isinstance(t_start, int) else None
    res["log"] = log
    return res


# ============================================================================ phase 1b lane A (live)
# A second plot north-east of the room: battery 2, a 4x3 conduit field (a TANGLE at the default threshold 9),
# a run east into a wall that carries one buried conduit cell (a live WALL terminal = downed wire, outdoors so
# it sways). Run after M8 (the break), so the west end of the gap is a LIVE floor terminal (whip) on screen.
# BAT2 / FIELD / RUN2 / WALL2 are set by _set_origin with the rest of the scene.
SHOTS = os.path.join(REPO, "Transient", "messy_conduit_live_20261002")


def shot(B, name, rect, log, pad=1, root=None):
    import shutil
    kw = {} if root is None else {"rootSize": root}
    r = B.call("rimworld/screenshot_cell_rect", x=rect[0], z=rect[1], width=rect[2], height=rect[3], paddingCells=pad,
               fileName=name, suppressMessage=True, **kw)
    src = r.get("path") or r.get("filePath")
    dst = None
    try:
        if src and os.path.exists(src):
            os.makedirs(SHOTS, exist_ok=True)
            dst = os.path.join(SHOTS, name + os.path.splitext(src)[1])
            shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001
        log.append("screenshot copy failed %s: %r" % (name, ex))
    log.append({"shot": name, "src": src, "dst": dst, "ok": r.get("success")})
    return dst


def motion(B, frames=2):
    """The motion counters describe the LAST drawn frame: read twice so a setting change has been drawn."""
    m = {}
    for _ in range(frames):
        m = B.probe("motion")
        time.sleep(0.25)
    return m


def lane_a_live(B, rows, log):
    b1 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("Wall", WALL2), stuff="Steel", faction="player")
    b2 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="Battery:%d,%d,0" % BAT2, faction="player")
    b3 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("PowerConduit", FIELD + RUN2), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
    bat2 = None
    for t in B.call("jawa/list_things", defName="Battery", limit=10).get("things") or []:
        pos = t.get("position") or t.get("pos") or t.get("cell")
        xz = (pos.get("x"), pos.get("z")) if isinstance(pos, dict) else (tuple(pos[:1]) + tuple(pos[-1:]) if pos else None)
        if xz == BAT2:                       # a dict pos used to be sliced first (TypeError) before its own branch
            bat2 = t.get("id") or t.get("thingId")
    if not bat2:
        lst = B.call("jawa/list_things", defName="Battery", limit=10).get("things") or []
        bat2 = (lst[-1].get("id") or lst[-1].get("thingId")) if lst else None
    bs = B.call("jawa/battery_set", thing=bat2, mode="setPct", value=1.0) if bat2 else {}
    frame_fit(B, SITE)   # 2026-10-10: the kept zoom can be a 12x6 view on the full list (B7 swayDraws 0, R2)
    B.ticks(2)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    B.probe("poll")
    m0 = motion(B)
    log.append({"lane_a_m0": m0, "plot": {"walls": b1.get("survived"), "battery": bat2, "conduit": b3.get("survived"),
                                          "stored": bs.get("storedEnergyAfter")}})
    hrow(rows, "P1B_plot_built", "PASS" if b3.get("survived") == len(FIELD + RUN2) and bs.get("storedEnergyAfter", 0) > 0 else "FAIL",
        "SITE", {"conduit": b3.get("survived"), "battery2": bat2, "stored": bs.get("storedEnergyAfter")})
    # owner review 2026-10-04 B1: power strips are the Modern (ExtensionCord) look only; the default Scrapper look's
    # pile is junction boxes. So the strip rows (B6, B6b) read the field in the Modern look; settle is look-agnostic.
    B.probe("set:style=ExtensionCord")
    B.ticks(2)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    m0 = motion(B)
    # B1 settle
    row(rows, "B1_rope_settle", "PASS" if m0.get("settledStrands", 0) > 0 and m0.get("settleMaxStretch", 1) < 0.03 and
        m0.get("settleMaxLenDev", 1) <= 0.05 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {k: m0.get(k) for k in ("settledStrands", "settleMaxStretch", "settleMaxLenDev", "endHeaps", "laidPoints", "lastRebuildMs")})
    # L2 tangle entity + lit strips
    row(rows, "B6_tangle_lit_strips", "PASS" if m0.get("tangles", 0) >= 1 and m0.get("tangleLitStrips", 0) > 0 and m0.get("tangleDarkStrips", 1) == 0 else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {k: m0.get(k) for k in ("tangles", "tangleMinUsed", "tangleLitStrips", "tangleDarkStrips", "litStrips", "darkStrips", "stubs", "mergedStubs")})
    shot(B, "p1b_01_wide", SITE, log)
    shot(B, "p1b_02_tangle_lit_and_downed_wire", (X0 + 18, Z0 + 6, 10, 6), log, root=7)
    # B3 whip
    w_on = m0.get("whipDraws", 0)
    B.probe("set:whip=False")
    frame_fit(B, SITE)   # the shots above re-centred the camera; whip draws count only what is on screen
    m1 = motion(B)
    B.probe("set:whip=True")
    m1b = motion(B)
    # the spark rides the whip (owner 2026-11-07): the glow's point differs from the laid tip and moves between two looks, paused or not
    tips0 = (motion(B).get("sparkTips") or [])
    time.sleep(0.4)
    tips1 = (motion(B).get("sparkTips") or [])
    rode = [a for a, b in zip(tips0, tips1) if a["laid"] == b["laid"] and a["now"] != b["now"] and (a["now"] != a["laid"] or b["now"] != b["laid"])]
    row(rows, "B3c_spark_rides_whip", "PASS" if tips0 and len(rode) == len(tips0) else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"ends": len(tips0), "rode": len(rode), "first": tips0[:2], "then": tips1[:2], "meaning": "PASS = every live floor end's spark point moves with its tail"})
    row(rows, "B3_whip_live_ends", "PASS" if w_on > 0 and m0.get("whipTails", 0) > 0 and m1.get("whipDraws") == 0 and m1b.get("whipDraws", 0) > 0 else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {"whipDraws_on": w_on, "whipTails": m0.get("whipTails"), "liveFloorEnds": m0.get("liveFloorEnds"),
                "deadFloorEnds": m0.get("deadFloorEnds"), "whipDraws_off": m1.get("whipDraws"), "whipDraws_on_again": m1b.get("whipDraws")})
    # B4 downed-wire schedule: real time, histogram of events (counts while paused; flecks only while time runs)
    B.probe("motionreset")
    hist, t0 = {}, time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < 45:
        time.sleep(5)
        hist = (B.probe("motion").get("downedHist") or {})
        if all(hist.get(k, 0) > 0 for k in ("Drip", "Flash", "Quiet", "Crackle")):
            break
    m2 = B.probe("motion")
    row(rows, "B4_downed_wire_bursts", "PASS" if m2.get("liveWallEnds", 0) >= 1 and all(hist.get(k, 0) > 0 for k in ("Drip", "Flash", "Quiet", "Crackle")) else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {"liveWallEnds": m2.get("liveWallEnds"), "hist": hist, "events": m2.get("dripEvents"), "seconds": int(time.time() - t0)})
    s0 = m2.get("sparksThrown", 0)
    B.ticks(160)
    m3 = B.probe("motion")
    row(rows, "B4b_sparks_thrown_ticking", "PASS" if m3.get("sparksThrown", 0) > s0 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"sparksBefore": s0, "sparksAfter160Ticks": m3.get("sparksThrown")})
    # B4c SPARK_EFFECT_BUDGET_REWORK_1 A2: sparkIntensity scales the sparks thrown by downed wall wires (credit k per event)
    spk = {}
    for k in ("0.5", "2"):
        B.probe("set:sparkIntensity=%s" % k)
        B.probe("motionreset")
        B.ticks(900)
        spk[k] = B.probe("motion").get("sparksThrown", 0)
    B.probe("set:sparkIntensity=1")
    row(rows, "B4c_spark_intensity_scales_downed", "PASS" if spk["2"] > 0 and spk["2"] >= 2 * max(spk["0.5"], 1) else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"sparksThrown900": spk, "liveWallEnds": m2.get("liveWallEnds")})
    # B4d SPARK_EFFECT_BUDGET_REWORK_1 A1: ONE shared spark set, capped at maxSparkingEnds in total, on-screen ends first.
    # The scene has only 2 live ends ~11 cells apart (one camera view holds both), so a powered 3-cell stub is built ~70 cells
    # away and the cap set to 1 (the same rule as "8 of many"): framed on the stub, the one chosen end must be ITS end (1 of 3
    # live ends on screen); framed on the scene, one of the scene's. Measured 2026-10-09: a whole-scene frame alone could not tell.
    fx, fz = (X0 - 70, Z0) if X0 >= 80 else (X0 + 70, Z0)
    frect = "%d,%d,8,6" % (fx - 1, fz - 1)
    OFF_SITE_RECTS.append(frect)         # review 9.8: torn down by the suite's finally even if a row below throws
    B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects=frect, categories="All")
    B.call("jawa/set_terrain_batch", ops="Soil:" + frect)
    B.call("jawa/set_fog", action="unfog", rect=frect)
    B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="Battery:%d,%d,0" % (fx, fz), faction="player")
    B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("PowerConduit", [(fx + 1, fz), (fx + 2, fz), (fx + 3, fz)]), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
    flt = B.call("jawa/list_things", defName="Battery", rect="%d,%d,1,2" % (fx, fz), limit=3)
    fbid = next((t.get("id") or t.get("thingId") for t in flt.get("things") or []), None)
    if fbid:
        B.call("jawa/battery_set", thing=fbid, mode="setPct", value=1.0)
    B.ticks(3)
    B.probe("poll")
    B.ticks(2)
    bud = {}
    B.probe("set:maxSparkingEnds=1")
    # 2026-10-10 (full 550-mod list): frame_cell_rect KEEPS the zoom, and the camera's root size was 24 there, a view 149
    # cells wide -- framed on the stub, the scene's ends ~80 cells away were on screen too (liveEndsOnScreen 2). The 11-mod

def same_frame_dirty_live(B, rows):
    """GPT pre-release A8 (PLAUSIBLE): a visible dirty event landing after this frame's rebuild may be dropped by the
    builtFrame latch (PiecesForSection rebuilds only when Time.frameCount != builtFrame). The probe's sameframe: verb does
    it all inside ONE frame (it runs in MapComponentUpdate): Rebuild(), one steel wall on a plain floor strand's middle
    cell in SITE (on screen), then vanilla Section.TryUpdate on the sections around it, which regenerates our layer and
    consumes the dirty flags. Two frames later `fresh` (a from-scratch build) must match the laid pieces and `strands:`
    must show every strand drawn by exactly one path. A wall that does not change the route proves nothing: SITE."""
    frame_fit(B, SITE)                        # on screen: the dirty patch leaves on-screen sections to the layer itself
    B.ticks(2)
    try:
        sf = B.probe("sameframe:%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)
        B.ticks(2)
        motion(B, 2)                          # >= 2 drawn frames after the probe frame (B.ticks alone may not render)
        fr = B.probe("fresh")
        st = B.probe("strands:%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)
    finally:                                  # review: the wall never outlives the row
        cl = B.probe("sameframe:clear")
    B.ticks(2)
    d = {k: sf.get(k) for k in ("success", "error", "cell", "oneFrame", "onScreen", "sectionsTried", "sectionsRegenerated",
                                "wallChangesRoute", "inFrameStale", "preHash", "afterRegenHash", "freshHash")}
    d.update({"fresh": {k: fr.get(k) for k in ("edges", "same", "different", "missing", "extra")},
              "badPaths": st.get("badPaths"), "cleared": cl.get("destroyed")})
    if not sf.get("success") or not sf.get("oneFrame") or not sf.get("onScreen") or not sf.get("wallChangesRoute") \
            or not sf.get("sectionsRegenerated") or not fr.get("success") or not fr.get("edges"):
        row(rows, "A8_same_frame_dirty_not_dropped", "UNMEASURED", "SITE", d)
        return
    ok = fr.get("different") == 0 and fr.get("missing") == 0 and fr.get("extra") == 0 and st.get("badPaths") == 0
    row(rows, "A8_same_frame_dirty_not_dropped", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "MOD", d)

SLIDE_FRAC = 0.18                    # CordGraph.SlideFrac
PLUG_OUT = 0.08                      # CordGraph.PlugPoint: the plug sits 0.08 outside the footprint side
FRAC_TOL = 0.025                     # 0.18+tol < 0.25-tol: the ON and OFF fraction sets never overlap


def plug_tip(poly, fp):
    """The plug point of one laid cord strand into a machine of footprint fp = (x0, z0, w, h), from the rect census
    polyline (stride 1). IntoArt appends the run from the plug point on into the centroid, so walk from the end that
    sits on the centroid outward; the first vertex at least 0.07 outside the footprint is the plug point (the slide's
    carry samples reach only 0.045 outside, the straight run's last sample 0.03). None when no end is on the centroid.
    Returns (x, z, side, frac): side 'x' when the plug is off an x side (its along coordinate is z), frac = the along
    coordinate's fraction within its cell."""
    if not poly or len(poly) < 2:
        return None
    x0, z0, w, h = fp
    x1, z1 = x0 + w, z0 + h
    cx, cz = x0 + w / 2.0, z0 + h / 2.0

    def near_c(p):
        return abs(p[0] - cx) < 0.06 and abs(p[1] - cz) < 0.06
    if near_c(poly[-1]):
        walk = list(reversed(poly))
    elif near_c(poly[0]):
        walk = list(poly)
    else:
        return None
    for x, z in walk:
        ox, oz = max(x0 - x, x - x1, 0.0), max(z0 - z, z - z1, 0.0)
        if max(ox, oz) >= 0.07:
            side = "x" if ox >= oz else "z"
            along = z if side == "x" else x
            return (x, z, side, round(along - math.floor(along), 4))
    return None


def slide_under_verdict(tips, slide_on):
    """M12 slideUnder, one side. ON every plug point sits SlideFrac (0.18) in from a corner of its cell along the side
    (0.18 or 0.82); OFF it sits on the hookup's cell centre clamped 0.25 in from the footprint corners (0.25, 0.5 or
    0.75). No tip -> (UNMEASURED, SITE): the heater never hooked up, the row could not ask."""
    if not tips:
        return "UNMEASURED", "SITE"
    targets = (SLIDE_FRAC, 1 - SLIDE_FRAC) if slide_on else (0.25, 0.5, 0.75)
    ok = all(any(abs(t[3] - g) <= FRAC_TOL for g in targets) for t in tips)
    return ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"), "MOD"


def slide_under_live(B, rows, log):
    """M12a/M12b (slideUnder, default on; GSS_SWITCHES_PROVE_LAST_FOUR_STANDING). A lone heater north of the main run
    (the M11 pocket cell, ring gone) cords to the conduit.
    PROVE  set:slideUnder=False / True, rebuild, rect census polylines (stride 1) -> plug_tip() of every strand that ends
           on the heater's centroid; geometryHash of the rect each way.
    EXPECT OFF: every plug fraction in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75} (+-0.025); ON: every one in {0.18, 0.82}; the hash differs
           ON vs OFF and the restored setting reads back (census settings) as it was before the row.
    LIES   a deployed build whose CordGraph.PlugPoint changed its constants reads FAIL, not a lie; a cord into some other
           machine whose end also lies on the heater centre would be counted (none in this rect); fewer than one strand
           each way is UNMEASURED/SITE, never a pass. It reads the laid geometry, not the drawn picture."""
    hx, hz = POCKET_HEATER
    rect = "%d,%d,%d,%d,200000" % (X0 + 3, Z0 + 3, 5, 9)
    fp = (hx, hz, 1, 1)
    prior = (B.probe("census").get("settings") or {}).get("slideUnder")
    h = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="Heater:%d,%d,0" % (hx, hz), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
    B.ticks(2)                       # the connector hooks up on the next tick (as M11)
    res = {}
    try:
        for val in ("False", "True"):
            s = B.probe("set:slideUnder=%s" % val)
            B.probe("rebuild")
            B.ticks(2)
            rc = B.probe("rect:" + rect)
            tips = [t for t in (plug_tip(p, fp) for p in rc.get("polylines") or []) if t]
            res[val] = {"readback": s.get("value"), "hash": rc.get("geometryHash"), "stride": rc.get("polyStride"),
                        "tips": tips, "rectOk": bool(rc.get("success"))}
    finally:
        back = "True" if prior not in ("True", "False") else prior
        B.probe("set:slideUnder=%s" % back)
        B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,1,1" % (hx, hz), categories="Building")
        B.probe("rebuild")
        after = (B.probe("census").get("settings") or {}).get("slideUnder")
    off, on = res.get("False", {}), res.get("True", {})
    d = {"heater": h.get("survived"), "off": off, "on": on, "prior": prior, "restored": after}
    log.append({"M12_slide_under": d})
    if after != back:
        row(rows, "M12_restore_setting", "FAIL", "HARNESS", {"prior": prior, "restored": after})
    ids = (("M12a_slide_under_off_plug_on_cell_centre", off, False, "False"),
           ("M12b_slide_under_on_plug_off_centre", on, True, "True"))
    stride1 = all(str(x.get("stride")) == "1" for x in (off, on))
    for rid, side, slide_on, want in ids:
        if not h.get("survived") or not side.get("rectOk") or not stride1:
            row(rows, rid, "UNMEASURED", "SITE" if not h.get("survived") else "HARNESS", d)
            continue
        st, cl = slide_under_verdict(side.get("tips"), slide_on)
        if st == "PASS" and (side.get("readback") != want or on.get("hash") == off.get("hash")):
            st = "FAIL"              # the switch did not take, or the geometry did not move
        row(rows, rid, st, cl, {"readback": side.get("readback"), "fracs": [t[3] for t in side.get("tips") or []],
                                "hashOff": off.get("hash"), "hashOn": on.get("hash"), "tips": side.get("tips")})

def style_live(B, rows, log, shots_prefix=None):

    the Jawa slots no family has art for), switching re-prints the section meshes with that style's strand,
    the extension-cord colour modes, the settings file round trip, and a clean return to the default."""
    per, st1 = {}, {}
    for st in STYLES:
        B.probe("set:style=%s" % st)
        B.ticks(1)
        time.sleep(0.5)
        c = B.probe("census")
        sp = B.probe("styles")
        per[st] = sp
        log.append({"style": st, "styles": sp})
        fb = set(sp.get("fallbacks") or [])
        allowed = set() if st == "StarWarsJawa" else ALLOWED_FALLBACKS
        ok = (sp.get("success") and not sp.get("nulls") and not sp.get("bad") and not sp.get("missing") and fb <= allowed and
              sp.get("builtKey") == sp.get("currentKey") and (sp.get("installed") or {}).get(st) and (c.get("layerVerts") or 0) > 0)
        st1[st] = {"ok": bool(ok), "strandTex": sp.get("strandTex"), "fallbacks": sorted(fb), "nulls": sp.get("nulls"),
                   "bad": sp.get("bad"), "missing": sp.get("missing"), "layerVerts": c.get("layerVerts")}
        if shots_prefix:
